arm.name: v1-dense
arm.what: the merged rule on the merged representation: the existing mechanism

arm.name: v1-sparse
arm.what: the merged rule on the sparse code

arm.name: v2
arm.what: the improved rule on the sparse code

arm.name: v2-dense
arm.what: the improved rule without the sparse code

arm.name: v2-thr-only
arm.what: the improved rule on a code made sparse by the KC threshold alone, without the antennal-lobe change

arm.name: v2-no-threshold
arm.what: every PAM spike counts as reward (theta 0)

arm.name: v2-dan-silenced
arm.what: PAM DANs silenced and their output blocked

arm.name: v2-reward-shuffled
arm.what: each plastic phase's rewards reassigned to random trials of that phase

arm.name: v2-pnkc-shuffled
arm.what: PN->KC synapses' targets permuted among KCs (each PN's out-degree and each KC's in-degree kept): disrupted connectivity

arm.name: v2-trace-no-trace
arm.what: the same with the eligibility trace removed (1 ms)

echo_mushroom_body.model: src/bethesda/fly/mushroomBody/circuit.ts (Bennett, Philippides & Nowotny 2021 MV model, rate units)
echo_mushroom_body.note: Cues are names, coded onto Kenyon cells at random by the model; Asim shares no cells with A by construction, unlike the connectome's similar odour. 'fruitless return' is the model's unrewarded trial (r = 0). Predictions rise with reward here; the connectome's MBON readout falls.
